name: Healthcare role-based frontend
summary: Seven dashboards verified at six widths; no claim that every possible UI state is exhaustively tested.

name: Hospital backend APIs
summary: Clinical writes, scheduling, billing, consent, staff and department operations are implemented. Role policy is fixed in code.

name: Clinical relational database
summary: 24 tables including migration metadata; 51 foreign keys. pg is the active query layer; the Prisma file is a legacy reference.

name: Clinical data security
summary: Server-side role, assignment, consent and ownership checks; token rotation/revocation; append-only audit trigger. No regulatory compliance claim.
endpoints: Authentication, clinical, billing, consent and FHIR APIs

name: Python clinical data processing
summary: Missing identity, invalid units, non-finite values, malformed reference metadata and timestamps are tested. Synthetic data only.
tests: pytest validator, security and benchmark tests

name: FastAPI clinical analytics
summary: No invented fallback values. An authenticated administrator token is forwarded to the authoritative Express projection; unavailable data returns 503 or null metrics.
tests: pytest HTTPX transport fixtures; actual PostgreSQL-to-FastAPI integration

name: Appointment and care workflow engine
summary: GiST exclusion constraint and transaction lock prevent overlaps. IANA zones and UTC instants are tested. Prescription/lab lifecycle transitions also exist as APIs.
sources: appointment.controller.ts; provider-workflow.controller.ts; services/availability.ts; SQL integrity migration
endpoints: Appointments, waiting list, encounters, prescription/lab status transitions

name: Healthcare interoperability
summary: FHIR is an explicit local R4-shaped mock. EMAIL/SMS delivery is a local database-backed simulator; no SMTP provider or external SMS delivery is verified.
tests: Four authenticated FHIR resource checks; durable sandbox worker/outage tests

name: Docker healthcare environment
summary: Builds and full Compose runtime passed in GitHub Actions. Non-root application UIDs and unexposed database/Redis ports are checked. Docker is unavailable on this Windows host.
endpoints: Frontend, API, analytics, PostgreSQL, Redis and separate worker
tests: Actual GitHub Actions containers job and container runtime logs

name: Git and clinical change review
summary: Original commit preserved; meaningful audit commits and feature branch pushed. GitHub rejected private-repository branch protection with HTTP 403. No peer approval is claimed.
sources: .github/CODEOWNERS; pull request template; review checklists; Git history

name: Healthcare CI/CD
summary: Tests, lint, type checks, dependency audit, migrations, browser checks and containers run in CI. The live demo was released through the authorized Render CLI; staged release hooks and protected environment reviewers remain unverified.
endpoints: GitHub Actions quality and container jobs; manual Render release hooks
tests: Actual successful CI runs and downloaded artifacts; Render deploy records

name: Privacy and workflow testing
summary: Executed results and coverage are reported exactly. Coverage is partial; memory-fixture tests are distinguished from actual PostgreSQL checks.
endpoints: Success, validation, privacy, concurrency and dependency failure paths

name: Healthcare API documentation
summary: Request schemas, examples, errors and permission rules are documented. FHIR success responses differ from the standard REST envelope.
endpoints: All 62 actual Express operations and five FastAPI analytics endpoints
tests: Router inventory generation; OpenAPI validation; live Swagger checks

name: Secure hospital deployment
summary: Three free services are live, using private existing datastore instances with a separate MediCore database/login and Redis database 2. All seven roles, care/billing/privacy, analytics and queue delivery were exercised. Off-host cloud backups, retention archival, a separate migration owner, dedicated worker and production availability remain outstanding.
endpoints: Public HTTPS frontend, Express API and FastAPI on Render
tests: render-deployment.json; live-results.json; live-playwright-results.json; genuine cloud screenshots

name: Healthcare incident simulation
summary: All incidents are controlled local simulations against synthetic data. They are not production incidents.
endpoints: Unauthorized access, collision, queue delay, database outage and lab association
tests: Real PostgreSQL, queue and outage evidence
